text: The J.J. Ugland Companies is a family-owned Norwegian shipping and investment group whose sole owner is Knut N.T. Ugland.
short: Knut N.T. Ugland is the sole owner of The J.J. Ugland Companies.

source.name: The J.J. Ugland Companies: About / History
source.quote: His grandson, Knut N.T. Ugland, is currently the sole owner of JJUC.
source.note: The same page describes JJUC as a 'family-owned business' spanning shipping and offshore, industry (Nymo), financial investments, fish farming, real estate and dairy production.
